form.label: Break-Glass Account (secadm)
form.description: Centralised view of every change made to, and every use of, the break-glass account(s) listed in adx_breakglass_accounts.csv, built from Windows Security events collected on the domain controllers (4624/4625, 4723/4724, 4738, 4722/4725, 4740/4767, 4728/4732/4756, 5136, 4672, 4648, 4768/4769/4771). Any non-zero red tile is an event worth correlating with an incident ticket.

html.p: Break-glass accounts are listed in lookups/adx_breakglass_accounts.csv. Normal state: ENABLED/DISABLED according to your policy, password rotated after each use, never used outside an incident. lastLogonTimestamp is replicated only every ~9-14 days: use the event panels below for real-time usage.

search.query: | `adx_users` | lookup adx_breakglass_accounts account AS sam OUTPUT label | where isnotnull(label) | eval status=if(is_disabled=1,"DISABLED","ENABLED"), locked=if(is_locked=1,"LOCKED","no"), never_expires=if(pwd_never_expires=1,"YES","no"), pwd_last_set=strftime(pwd_last_set,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), last_logon_replicated=strftime(last_logon,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), privileged=if(is_privileged=1,"YES","no") | table sam status locked pwd_last_set pwd_age_days never_expires last_logon_replicated privileged memberOf
`adx_breakglass_events` | search (event_id=4625 OR event_id=4771) tgt_bg=* | stats count
`adx_breakglass_events` | search (event_id=4723 OR event_id=4724 OR event_id=4794) tgt_bg=* | stats count
`adx_breakglass_events` | search (event_id=4738 OR event_id=4722 OR event_id=4725 OR event_id=4726 OR event_id=4781 OR event_id=4767 OR event_id=4740 OR event_id=5136) tgt_bg=* | stats count
`adx_breakglass_events` | search act_bg=* (category="Account Management" OR category="Group Management" OR category="Directory Service Changes") | stats count

panel.title: Change log: who changed the account, when, from where

search.query: `adx_breakglass_events` | search tgt_bg=* (category="Account Management" OR category="Group Management" OR category="Directory Service Changes") | eval changed_by=actor_user, group=group_name, object_attribute=if(event_id="5136", AttributeLDAPDisplayName." = ".coalesce(AttributeValue,""), null()) | sort - _time | table _time action target_user changed_by group object_attribute src_host src_ip dc event_id

`adx_breakglass_events` | search event_id=4624 tgt_bg=* | lookup adx_logon_types logon_type OUTPUT logon_type_label | eval auth_package=coalesce(AuthenticationPackageName, Authentication_Package), process=coalesce(LogonProcessName, Logon_Process) | sort - _time | table _time target_user logon_type_label src_ip src_host dc auth_package process

`adx_breakglass_events` | search (event_id=4625 OR event_id=4771) tgt_bg=* | eval code=coalesce(Sub_Status, SubStatus, Failure_Code, Status) | lookup adx_failure_codes code OUTPUT reason | sort - _time | table _time action target_user reason code src_ip src_host dc

panel.title: Actions performed BY the break-glass account

search.query: `adx_breakglass_events` | search act_bg=* (category="Account Management" OR category="Group Management" OR category="Directory Service Changes") | eval affected_object=coalesce(group_name." <- ".target_user, target_user) | sort - _time | table _time action actor_user affected_object src_host src_ip dc

`adx_breakglass_events` | search (event_id=4672 OR event_id=4648) | eval privileges=coalesce(PrivilegeList, Privileges) | sort - _time | table _time action target_user actor_user src_host dc privileges
`adx_breakglass_events` | search event_id=4624 tgt_bg=* | eval source=coalesce(src_host, src_ip, "local / unknown") | stats count by source | sort - count | head 15
`adx_breakglass_events` | search tgt_bg=* (category="Account Management" OR category="Group Management") | stats count by actor_user | sort - count
`adx_breakglass_events` | search event_id=4624 tgt_bg=* | eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H") | stats count by hour | sort hour

panel.title: Source hosts seen for the first time (last 7 days vs 90-day baseline)

html.p: Fixed 90-day lookback, independent of the time picker.

search.query: `adx_breakglass_events` | search event_id=4624 tgt_bg=* | eval source=coalesce(src_host, src_ip, "local / unknown") | stats min(_time) as first_seen, max(_time) as last_seen, count by source | where first_seen>relative_time(now(),"-7d") | eval first_seen=strftime(first_seen,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), last_seen=strftime(last_seen,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
